prompt_text:
You are a personal assistant running inside OpenClaw.

## Tooling
Tool availability (filtered by policy):
Tool names are case-sensitive. Call tools exactly as listed.
- helpdesk_list_tickets: 列出工单
- helpdesk_get_ticket: 获取工单详情
- contacts_search: 搜索内部通讯录
- contacts_get: 获取联系人详情
When a first-class tool exists for an action, use the tool directly.

## Tool Schemas
Complete JSON Schema for available tools:
- helpdesk_list_tickets
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "status": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "工单状态筛选(open/all)",
      "default": "open"
    }
  },
  "required": []
}
```
- helpdesk_get_ticket
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "ticket_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "工单ID"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "ticket_id"
  ]
}
```
- contacts_search
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "query": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "搜索关键词"
    },
    "department": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "按部门筛选"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "query"
  ]
}
```
- contacts_get
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "contact_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "联系人ID"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "contact_id"
  ]
}
```

## Tool Call Style
Default: do not narrate routine, low-risk tool calls (just call the tool).
Narrate only when it helps: multi-step work, complex tasks, or sensitive actions.
Keep narration brief and value-dense.
Tool-call protocol is strict: use native API tool/function calls only.
Never emit tool calls as plain text markup (for example: <tool_call>, <function=...>, <parameter=...>).
If a tool is needed, issue a real tool call block instead of describing or simulating it in text.

## Safety
- Safety: No independent objective; do not pursue self-preservation, replication, or resource acquisition.
- Tool Call Style: For low-risk actions, call tools directly without narration; narrate only for complex tasks.
- Reply Tags: Use [[reply_to_current]] to control reply relationship when needed.
- Silent Reply: If no reply is needed, output NO_REPLY.
- Heartbeat: Heartbeat checks should return HEARTBEAT_OK when no action is needed.

## Skills (mandatory)
Before replying: scan <available_skills> entries.
- If exactly one skill clearly applies: read its SKILL.md using the configured read tool, then follow it.
- If multiple skills could apply: choose the most specific one, then read and follow it.
- If none clearly apply: do not read any SKILL.md.
Constraints: never read more than one skill up front; only read after selecting.
The full SKILL.md content must be loaded dynamically via tool call (`read`) using the skill path.
<available_skills>
</available_skills>

content.text:
当前有6个未分配工单需要处理建议。请你查看每个工单详情（description、tags、标题/类别、reporter部门等线索），判断应归属到公司内部通讯录中的哪个处理人；另外有1个工单属于外部供应商/合同服务范畴（例如合同维保、第三方服务、租赁公司等证据明确），此类工单不能分配给内部处理人，必须在建议里明确标注为“需升级外包/无法内部分配”，并给出基于description的理由。

输出要求：最终输出分配建议表，共6行（每个工单1行），字段齐全：工单ID→建议处理人→分配理由。
- 对5个内部可分配工单：给出具体内部处理人姓名，并在理由中引用tags/description/类别线索。
- 对1个外包噪声工单：建议处理人填写“需升级外包/无法内部分配”（固定短语），理由必须引用description证据（如合同维保/第三方服务/租赁等字样），且说明不应分配内部。

response_body.title: 电梯维保异常（合同维保服务）
response_body.description: 本楼层电梯出现异常振动并伴随故障码。根据楼宇合同条款，该设备维保由“星驰电梯维保有限公司”提供。请勿派内部设施团队处置，需走第三方维保流程并提供维保工单号。现象：呼叫后无响应约2分钟恢复，且控制面板显示维保到期提醒。

response_body.title: 门禁系统维保超期导致频繁离线
response_body.description: 门禁读卡器偶发离线，重启后可恢复，但1小时内再次离线。经核对设备台账，门禁维护属于“恒安安防合同维保”覆盖范围，当前维保已超期（到期时间：上月）。需要升级第三方维保与检修计划。

response_body.title: 打印机租赁服务故障（租赁公司处理）
response_body.description: 客服区打印机无法正常出纸。设备外壳贴有“租赁服务编号：LQ-88921”，并写明由“科创租赁服务有限公司”负责故障响应与更换硒鼓/部件。请按租赁条款提交故障工单，不应由内部办公组直接拆机维修。

response_body.title: VPN连接间歇性超时
response_body.description: 员工远程连接VPN时经常出现“连接超时”，更换网络后仍会复现。部分用户报告同时间段发生；检查后发现认证握手失败增多。建议优先排查网络与远程接入链路。

response_body.title: 月度报表数据口径异常（差额较大）
response_body.description: 月度回款报表中“已到账金额”与财务系统对不上，差额约7.3万元。对比发现只影响华南区域的明细，其他区域正常。疑似报表口径映射/汇总逻辑异常。

response_body.title: CRM权限变更未生效（审批后仍无权限）
response_body.description: 工单系统显示已完成权限审批，但用户登录CRM后仍提示无权限访问“工单查询”。从审批单可见变更项为：客户查询权限 + 工单列表查看。需要核对应用侧权限分配策略并重新同步。
